patterns.note: Content is centered within full-width sections, often framed by a dark, immersive background that extends across the entire viewport.
Headings use a distinctively rounded, playful sans-serif typeface, contrasting with a clean, modern sans-serif for body text and labels.
A deep, dark blue-purple serves as the primary background, providing a canvas for vibrant, often glowing, accent colors and white text.
The hero section features a multi-layered parallax effect where the 3D 'Things' logo and clouds move at different rates against the starry background as the user scrolls.
Content sections like 'Our Things' and 'Log Book' utilize a grid of cards with heavily rounded corners, each containing a distinct visual or content snippet.

technique_notes: The immersive background is created using a dark gradient with subtle starfield and grid overlay patterns that remain fixed or parallax gently. High-quality 3D rendered elements are integrated directly into the page content, appearing to float or rest on the background.

Scroll-triggered animations, likely using GSAP ScrollTrigger, are employed to create a parallax effect on the hero's 3D logo and clouds, making them move independently of the background. Sections and individual content cards are revealed with a subtle fade-up or slide-up animation as they enter the viewport, enhancing engagement. The 'Scroll' indicator button also fades out as the user begins to scroll.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, playful, rounded sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) with clear hierarchy, complemented by a clean, legible sans-serif for body text.
design_tokens.radius: Very rounded, almost pill-like on smaller interactive elements and buttons, with large, soft rounded corners consistently applied to all content cards and section containers.
design_tokens.spacing: Generally airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and balanced padding within content blocks, creating a spacious and uncrowded feel.

standout: The site's design is highly distinctive for its immersive, dark, and playful aesthetic, driven by the prominent use of high-quality, glowing 3D rendered elements. The 'Things' logo and various illustrative objects create a unique, almost dreamlike or game-like atmosphere that sets it apart from typical corporate or tech sites.
